preconditions.description: The number of levels n must be between 1 and 7000.
The number of operations m must be between 1 and 7000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= n and 1 <= l <= r <= cnt[t] and 1 <= x <= 10**6 for op in operations if op[0] == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, t must be a valid level, l and r must be valid positions, and x must be a valid value.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= n and 1 <= v <= cnt[t] for op in operations if op[0] == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 operations, t must be a valid level and v must be a valid position.

postconditions.description: For each type 2 operation, the output must be the size of the union of sets in the subtree.
